name: Dave Wood

summary.text: Dave Wood (listed by Ballotpedia as David Wood) is a retired computer programmer from Westminster, Colorado, running as the Libertarian candidate for Colorado's 8th Congressional District.

experience.text: Worked as a computer programmer; now retired.

positions.quote: We need Free Trade. Imposing tariffs on foreign goods raises the cost of raw materials and manufactured products, shifting those higher expenses onto us, as struggling consumers.
positions.note: Date is when he submitted the Candidate Connection survey, per the page's footnote.

positions.quote: Stop the shameful deporting of peaceful hard-working immigrants and increase the number of immigration judges so immigrants can get timely due process in applying for citizenship.
positions.note: Date is when he submitted the Candidate Connection survey, per the page's footnote.

sources.title: Colorado U.S. House District 8 candidate Q&A

research_notes: Ballotpedia's page for this candidate is titled 'David Wood'; the assignment's name 'Dave Wood' is used in the output to match the ballot-order id. No campaign finance data available from the FEC as of the page's last update. Did not independently fetch davewood4colorado.com beyond confirming the URL on Ballotpedia, given the short-profile effort budget and that the Candidate Connection survey already covered his key messages (foreign policy/troop withdrawal, immigration, tariffs, debt) in his own words. No statements found on abortion, guns, health care, or Colorado ballot measures. Second pass 2026-10-14: added public-lands from the Denver Post's CD8 candidate Q&A, which prints detailed first-person answers under 'David Wood' matching his Ballotpedia survey almost word for word on tariffs and immigration (confirming they are genuinely his) -- despite the same page's trailing note stating 'Dave Wood did not return the questionnaire,' which appears to be a stale editorial artifact rather than accurate; a reviewer should double-check this discrepancy with the Denver Post if possible.
